title: KUKL water-distribution schedules
description: Per-branch drinking-water distribution schedules published by Kathmandu Upatyaka Khanepani Limited: reservoirs, zones, delivery days, time windows, served areas and contact details, extracted from the utility's monthly PDF/XLSX releases.
grain: one record per branch × month, with reservoirs and zones nested

coverage.note: Bikram Sambat; schedule.json holds the latest extracted month per branch

verification.method: extracted from the utility's published source files and cross-checked against the listing page; prose/schedule content, so there are no printed totals to reconcile

notes: No build fingerprint yet: schedule.json is regenerated by `python -m water_parser.cli build` but is not hashed.
The scrape inventory records 231 source files with most still pending, so coverage is limited to the months already processed.

license.data: Published by KUKL for public use; attribution required
